name: Root Beer
siboNotes: Traditional root beer is typically FODMAP-free, but check labels for high fructose corn syrup or artificial sweeteners like sorbitol which could trigger SIBO symptoms.
preparationTips: Choose brands made with cane sugar rather than high fructose corn syrup
Avoid diet versions that may contain polyol sweeteners
Look for natural root beer brands with simpler ingredient lists
Serve chilled for best flavor and reduced gas formation
nutritionalHighlights: Contains carbonation which may aid digestion
Traditional varieties may contain trace minerals from natural root extracts
Provides quick energy from simple sugars
